text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 大家好,欢迎收听《Real Easy English》,
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收聽《Real Easy English》,

text: the podcast where we have real conversations
zh: 在这个播客里,我们会用简单的英语进行真实的对话,
zh_hant: 在這個播客裡,我們會用簡單的英語進行真實的對話,

text: in easy English to help you learn.
I’m Georgie.
And I'm Neil, and don't forget that this podcast is now available
zh: 我是Neil,别忘了这个播客现在可以在我们的网站上
zh_hant: 我是Neil,別忘了這個播客現在可以在我們的網站上

text: as a video on our website,
so you can watch us at bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi, Neil.
How are you today?
Hi, Georgie.
I'm very well, actually.
I'm really happy today
because the Sun is shining, and it's warm,
zh: 阳光明媚,天气也很暖和,
zh_hant: 陽光明媚,天氣也很暖和,

text: and it seems like it's been a long time
since we had such nice sunny weather.
I know, the changing of the seasons is so wonderful,
zh: 是啊,季节的变换真的很美妙,
zh_hant: 是啊,季節的變換真的很美妙,

text: and actually, that's what we're talking about today.
zh: 其实,这正是我们今天要聊的话题。
zh_hant: 其實,這正是我們今天要聊的話題。

text: we're going to talk about the seasons and the different types of weather
zh: 我们要聊聊季节,以及英国
zh_hant: 我們要聊聊季節,以及英國

text: we get in the UK.
Yes.
So in the UK
we, our seasons are roughly like this.
zh: 我们的季节大致是这样划分的。
zh_hant: 我們的季節大致是這樣劃分的。

text: So March, April,
May those are the spring seasons.
Then we move into summer, which is June, July and August.
zh: 接下来是夏季,也就是六月、七月和八月。
zh_hant: 接下來是夏季,也就是六月、七月和八月。

text: Autumn, that's September, October, November.
zh: 秋季是九月、十月、十一月。
zh_hant: 秋季是九月、十月、十一月。

text: And then we're into winter for December, January, February.
zh: 然后就是冬季,十二月、一月、二月。
zh_hant: 然後就是冬季,十二月、一月、二月。

text: Yeah.
More or less.
Approximately.
Yeah.
So, Neil, what is your favourite season?
zh: 那么,Neil,你最喜欢哪个季节?
zh_hant: 那麼,Neil,你最喜歡哪個季節?

text: Well, you can probably guess because I'm so happy
zh: 你大概能猜到,因为我这么开心,
zh_hant: 你大概能猜到,因為我這麼開心,

text: that it's spring and summer combined.
zh: 说明是春夏交替的时候。
zh_hant: 說明是春夏交替的時候。

text: So anything with long late
nights and evenings I love.
zh: 夜晚晚的时节我都喜欢。
zh_hant: 夜晚晚的時節我都喜歡。

text: What else is good about summer?
In the summer, you can be outside.
You can go swimming in the sea.
You can stay up late
and you have wonderful light in the UK.
zh: 而且英国的光线特别美。
zh_hant: 而且英國的光線特別美。

text: What's your favourite season then, Georgie?
zh: 那你最喜欢哪个季节呢,Georgie?
zh_hant: 那你最喜歡哪個季節呢,Georgie?

text: Well, I'm a big fan of the seasons,
the transition seasons.
So I really like spring and autumn,
zh: 所以我特别喜欢春天和秋天,
zh_hant: 所以我特別喜歡春天和秋天,

text: especially spring.
Right now we're in spring in the UK,
and you can see everyone looking happier
zh: 你可以看到每个人看起来都更开心了,
zh_hant: 你可以看到每個人看起來都更開心了,

text: because we've had a really long, hard,
zh: 因为我们经历了一个漫长、艰难、
zh_hant: 因為我們經歷了一個漫長、艱難、

text: dark, cold winter
and everyone is smiling now
zh: 现在大家都露出了笑容,
zh_hant: 現在大家都露出了笑容,

text: because they there are blossoms on the trees
which make me so happy.
I love seeing pink blossoms on the trees.
zh: 我喜欢看到树上粉色的花朵。
zh_hant: 我喜歡看到樹上粉色的花朵。

text: The days are warmer and, yeah,
there's this sense of a transition.
Same with autumn.
Although you're leaving the summer months,
I really love the colours on the trees
zh: 但我真的很喜欢树叶的颜色,
zh_hant: 但我真的很喜歡樹葉的顏色,

text: as well.
Especially those cooler, crisp days
zh: 尤其是那种凉爽清新的日子,
zh_hant: 尤其是那種涼爽清新的日子,

text: when the sky is blue and the leaves
are orange and brown.
I love that.
Wow.
You're making me look forward to autumn, and it's not even summer yet.
zh: 你让我开始期待秋天了,可现在夏天都还没到呢。
zh_hant: 你讓我開始期待秋天了,可現在夏天都還沒到呢。

text: Is there a season that you don't like?
zh: 有没有你不喜欢的季节?
zh_hant: 有沒有你不喜歡的季節?

text: I do like all the seasons.
zh: 其实我喜欢所有的季节。
zh_hant: 其實我喜歡所有的季節。

text: I like to have balance,
so I wouldn't like to have summer all year round,
zh: 所以我不希望一年到头都是夏天,
zh_hant: 所以我不希望一年到頭都是夏天,

text: but I think, winter
is my least favourite
because of the dark days.
zh: 因为白天太短太黑暗了。
zh_hant: 因為白天太短太黑暗了。

text: In the UK I think
it's particularly hard
because,
especially January and February,
it's really cold
and there's nothing really to get us
through the the sad times.
I know exactly what you mean.
There are good things about winter,
but mostly it's just difficult, isn't it?
zh: 但大多数时候确实挺难熬的,对吧?
zh_hant: 但大多數時候確實挺難熬的,對吧?

text: I agree.
It's the dark.
I can't stand it.
Yeah.
So, as I said,
I quite like having the balance of different seasons
throughout the year.
zh: 各不相同带来的平衡感。
zh_hant: 各不相同帶來的平衡感。

text: I like to have transitions and changes.
What about you, Neil?
How do you feel about that?
Yeah, I think I agree.
I mean, it would be nice to have a shorter winter,
zh: 我是说,如果冬天能短一点会更好,
zh_hant: 我是說,如果冬天能短一點會更好,

text: but I think I would still prefer to have different seasons
zh: 但我觉得我还是更喜欢有不同的季节,
zh_hant: 但我覺得我還是更喜歡有不同的季節,

text: because, like I said,
I really like the late
light evenings in the summer.
zh: 那种天黑得晚、光线柔和的傍晚。
zh_hant: 那種天黑得晚、光線柔和的傍晚。

text: And I think even though I hate the dark winters,
zh: 而且我觉得,虽然我讨厌冬天的黑暗,
zh_hant: 而且我覺得,雖然我討厭冬天的黑暗,

text: I would really miss that if the weather was nice all year,
zh: 但如果一年到头天气都很好,
zh_hant: 但如果一年到頭天氣都很好,

text: but got dark at the same time, like at six or seven o'clock.
zh: 却在六七点就天黑了,我一定会很怀念这种变化。
zh_hant: 卻在六七點就天黑了,我一定會很懷念這種變化。

text: OK, let's recap the language we heard in the conversation.
zh: 好,让我们回顾一下对话中出现的表达。
zh_hant: 好,讓我們回顧一下對話中出現的表達。

text: We learned different ways to talk about the seasons.
zh: 我们学到了几种谈论季节的说法。
zh_hant: 我們學到了幾種談論季節的說法。

text: For example, looking forward to that means
you're excited for something to happen in the future.
zh: 你对未来将要发生的事感到期待和兴奋。
zh_hant: 你對未來將要發生的事感到期待和興奮。

text: That's right.
So I'm really looking forward to the warm,
zh: 所以我真的很期待夏天里
zh_hant: 所以我真的很期待夏天裡

text: light, sunny evenings in the summer.
zh: 那种温暖、明亮、阳光灿烂的傍晚。
zh_hant: 那種溫暖、明亮、陽光燦爛的傍晚。

text: We heard to be a big fan of that means that you really like something.
zh: 我们还听到be a big fan of,意思是你非常喜欢某样东西。
zh_hant: 我們還聽到be a big fan of,意思是你非常喜歡某樣東西。

text: For example, I'm a big fan of spring and autumn.
zh: 比如,我很喜欢春天和秋天。
zh_hant: 比如,我很喜歡春天和秋天。

text: Yes, Georgie is a big fan of the transition seasons.
zh: 没错,Georgie特别喜欢这些过渡季节。
zh_hant: 沒錯,Georgie特別喜歡這些過渡季節。

text: I'm not such a big fan of winter, though.
zh: 不过我就不太喜欢冬天了。
zh_hant: 不過我就不太喜歡冬天了。

text: I, actually, I can't stand it,
which means that I really hate it.
zh: 意思是我真的很讨厌它。
zh_hant: 意思是我真的很討厭它。

text: Thanks for listening to Real Easy English.
We've talked about the seasons in the UK,
but the seasons are different all around the world.
zh: 但世界各地的季节各不相同。
zh_hant: 但世界各地的季節各不相同。

text: What are the seasons like where you live?
zh: 你所在的地方季节是什么样的呢?
zh_hant: 你所在的地方季節是什麼樣的呢?

text: Email us at learningenglish@bbc.co.uk.
We always like to hear from you.
zh: 我们一直很期待收到你的来信。
zh_hant: 我們一直很期待收到你的來信。

text: In the next episode, we talk about what life was like when we were children.
zh: 下一期节目中,我们会聊聊我们小时候的生活是什么样的。
zh_hant: 下一期節目中,我們會聊聊我們小時候的生活是什麼樣的。

text: Join us then.
Goodbye.
Bye.
